text: Completed the targeted EyeLink semantic mutation court. Added EyeLinkAscMutationSuite with 11 named non-vacuous assertions and executed every required production mutant on JVM and Scala.js: swapped eyes, ignored START declarations, inherited a prior block layout, dropped MSG, ignored signed message offsets, coerced dot gaze to zero, relabelled unconfirmed missing gaze as Blink, accepted HREF as pixels, discarded unknown records, omitted EOF block flush, and downgraded converter provenance. Every mutant failed its intended assertion on both platforms; no survivors or equivalent mutants. All production mutations were restored and the baseline suite passes 11/11 on JVM and 11/11 on Scala.js. Machine-readable receipts record commands, assertions, observed failures, platforms, base commit 44b014581412243e8354021bfbb08961090df91f, and restored source-set digest 6fb2073204b5e61cb5767e08da213e1eab5b0ea8e64354edf4651ed86eeb6c68. The receipts ship at META-INF/eyes4s/eyelink/mutation-receipts.tsv; ioJVM/packageBin produced a JAR containing that entry and an extraction audit found all 11 unique killed rows. Final io regression: JVM 142/142, Scala.js 128/128, both scalafmt checks and git diff --check green.
